units.label: paragraph 2
units.text: International Criminal Court (ICC) and the International Court of Justice (ICJ)

units.label: table 3
units.text:
Question	Answer
What is the primary goal and purpose of the ICC and ICJ?	
In what ways do the ICJ and ICC contribute to maintaining peace and accountability in the world?	
How did the events of World War II influence the creation of both the ICJ and ICC?	
What is an International Criminal Tribunal? What kinds of crimes do they hear?	
Why do you think the ICJ’s rulings are often described as “nonbinding”? What challenges might this create in enforcing its decisions?	
The ICC acts only when a country is “unable or unwilling” to prosecute war crimes. What are some possible reasons a nation might be unwilling to prosecute its own citizens?	
What are the advantages/disadvantages of having an international court settle disputes between nations?	
Do you think having two separate international courts (ICJ and ICC) makes global justice more effective or more complicated? Explain your reasoning.
